def test_get_closest_vowel():

    assert get_closest_vowel("a") == ""

    # Closest vowel found from the right side
    assert get_closest_vowel("banana") == "a"

    # No vowels at all
    assert get_closest_vowel("rhythm") == ""

    print("All tests passed!")

def test_get_closest_vowel():
    # Standard examples
    assert get_closest_vowel("yogurt") == "u"
    assert get_closest_vowel("FULL") == "U"
    assert get_closest_vowel("quick") == ""   # vowels are adjacent to other vowels
    assert get_closest_vowel("ab") == ""      # too short

    # Words shorter than 3 characters
    assert get_closest_vowel("") == ""
    assert get_closest_vowel("a") == ""
    assert get_closest_vowel("Ay") == ""
    assert get_closest_vowel("xo") == ""

    # Single vowel between consonants (qualifies)
    assert get_closest_vowel("cat") == "a"
    assert get_closest_vowel("full") == "u"
    assert get_closest_vowel("bAc") == "A"    # uppercase vowel handled
    assert get_closest_vowel("xEz") == "E"

    # No vowels at all
    assert get_closest_vowel("rhythm") == ""
    assert get_closest_vowel("xyz") == ""
    assert get_closest_vowel("BCDFG") == ""

    # Adjacent vowels disqualify each other
    assert get_closest_vowel("AEIOU") == ""
    assert get_closest_vowel("aei") == ""
    assert get_closest_vowel("boat") == ""    # 'o' and 'a' adjacent to vowels/consonant chain
    assert get_closest_vowel("team") == ""    # 'e' next to 'a'

    # Rightmost qualifying vowel wins (search proceeds from the end)
    assert get_closest_vowel("banana") == "a"
    assert get_closest_vowel("CEQAZ") == "A"
    assert get_closest_vowel("instantiation") == "a"

    print("All tests passed!")
